about: The heading of a reading from the book of Revelation, the Apocalypse of Saint John the Apostle. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Epistles of All Saints, of the Holy Innocents, of the Dedication of Saint Michael the Archangel and of the Dedication of the Archbasilica of the Most Holy Savior, among other Masses.

s01.translation: A reading from the book of Revelation of blessed John the Apostle
